title: Browser constraint-validation state
description: The browser's ValidityState for a field (valueMissing, tooShort, rangeOverflow, patternMismatch, typeMismatch).
oracle_strategy: Read element.validity after input/submit. Expected flag comes from the HTML declaration.
false_positive_warnings: Proves only browser enforcement, never server enforcement
confidence_requirements: Confirmed outcome for the browser layer only.

title: Stored value length
description: Length of the field's value after input (maxlength truncation).

title: Feedback attributable to the violated rule
description: After submission, rejection counts only if the field itself is invalid or a visible message names the field or the rule.
oracle_strategy: Keywords from the field's label/name and the rule kind; unrelated errors (e.g. invalid credentials) do not count.
false_positive_warnings: A generic 'error' banner is not attributable
Silent acceptance may be intended when the rule is only inferred
confidence_requirements: Confirmed only with a requirement or browser-layer rule; likely when the rule is HTML-declared/semantic.

title: Browser vs. server layer distinction
description: The same rule is checked twice: once with browser validation active, once with client validation disabled.
false_positive_warnings: Disabling client validation is a controlled probe; it must be authorized

title: Observed-state regression
description: Routes, headings and transitions observed during this investigation are expected to recur.

title: Collection ordering / filtering invariant
description: Detected record collection is ordered by, or filtered on, the key the chosen option names.
confidence_requirements: Unverified anomaly unless a requirement states the rule.

title: Rendering-anomaly invariant
description: Visible text contains no NaN, undefined, null, [object Object] or exception traces.
false_positive_warnings: Pages documenting code may legitimately contain these words

title: Heuristic accessible-name computation
description: aria-label, labels, label[for], title, placeholder and text content; >20% unnamed controls fails.

title: Insufficient observability
description: When the oracle cannot observe what it needs (no records, no status, unknown rule) the outcome is INCOMPLETE, never PASS or FAIL.
